'''Ross County Football Club''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Dingwall]], Scotland. The club play in {{Scottish football updater|RossCoun}} after their relegation from the [[Scottish Championship]] in the [[2025–26 Ross County F.C. season|2025–26]] season.

Prior to the 1994–95 season Ross County played in the [[Highland Football League]], a competition they won three times. They have also won the [[Scottish Football League First Division|Scottish First Division]], [[Scottish Championship]], [[Scottish Football League Second Division|Second Division]], [[Scottish Football League Third Division|Third Division]] (once each) and the [[Scottish Challenge Cup|Challenge Cup]] on three occasions. In 2010, they reached the [[Scottish Cup]] Final, and in 2016 they won the [[Scottish League Cup]]. The club's nickname is ''The Staggies'', and its colours are dark blue, red and white."}}
